messages.text: The visual artifacts were written into nested Playwright result folders, so the first directory-level media read only saw the run manifest. I’m opening the exact desktop/mobile storefront and preview captures now and starting the built app with a tracked PID and bounded readiness check; if the captures show any clipping or density failure, I’ll correct that before delivery.

commands.commandLine: {"command":"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .tura/logs | Out-Null; $out=(Resolve-Path .tura/logs).Path+'\\preview.stdout.log'; $err=(Resolve-Path .tura/logs).Path+'\\preview.stderr.log'; $p=Start-Process -FilePath 'cmd.exe' -ArgumentList '/c','npx vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3200' -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location).Path -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru; Set-Content .tura/preview.pid $p.Id; $ready=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 40;$i++){ Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $p.Refresh(); if($p.HasExited){ Write-Error \"Preview exited $($p.ExitCode): $(Get-Content $err -Tail 20)\"; exit 1 }; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:3200 -TimeoutSec 2; if($r.StatusCode -eq 200){$ready=$true;break} } catch {} }; if(-not $ready){Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force; Write-Error 'Preview readiness timeout'; exit 1}; Write-Output \"Preview ready at http://127.0.0.1:3200 (PID $($p.Id))\"","workdir":"C:\\Users\\liuliu\\Documents\\tura-benchmark\\raw\\project-rebuild-makeup-tanstack-fullstack\\g56-fs-td2-20260710b\\projects\\makeup-tura-direct","timeout_ms":30000}
commands.preview: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .tura/logs | Out-Null; $out=(Resolve-Path .tura/logs).Path+'\preview.stdout.log'; $err=(Resolve-Path .tura/logs).Path+'\preview.stderr.log'; $p=Start-Process -FilePath 'cmd.exe' -ArgumentList '/c','npx vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3200' -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location).Path -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru; Set-Content .tura/preview.pid $p.Id; $ready=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 40;$i++){ Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $p.Refresh(); if($p.HasExited){ Write-Error "Preview exited $($p.ExitCode): $(Get-Content $err -Tail 20)"; exit 1 }; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:3200 -TimeoutSec 2; if($r.StatusCode -eq 200){$ready=$true;break} } catch {} }; if(-not $ready){Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force; Write-Error 'Preview readiness timeout'; exit 1}; Write-Output "Preview ready at http://127.0.0.1:3200 (PID $($p.Id))"
